meta.title: Workspace recency and pin
meta.description: Sorts the sidebar's workspaces the way the Session list's "Last updated" order works: pinned workspaces lead, then everything else by the most recent activity of the Sessions inside. Right-click a workspace row, or open its "..." menu, to pin or unpin it; the menu icon matches the Session rows' pin icon. The order is automatic, so dragging a workspace is temporary. In the Workspace tree grouping a pinned workspace only leads its own siblings.
